correctness.rationale: The explicit elementwise assembly yields M=ell(2D+A)/6, K=(D-A)/ell with positive definite M. A full M-orthogonal generalized eigenbasis has eigenvalues 0,3/ell^2,12/ell^2, producing exact projectors and four entry classes. All opposite-part entries are positive. Same-part entries force x>=1/(6theta) for positive times; the smallest diagonal is controlled by F_m. Its sign at the lower boundary, concavity or nonnegative coefficients, and unique root establish all theta regimes and endpoints. Independent exact-rational Gauss-Jordan versus projector replay passed 2952 cases; proof covers all p,q,theta,t in domain.

value.rationale: Positivity preservation is an essential discrete maximum-principle property on branched wire networks. Exact design guidance identifies a previously nontrivial isolated admissible step at theta=1/3, a sharp all-theta finite-window/half-line transition at theta=1-1/(2max(p,q)), and a computable exact finite upper CFL root depending only on the larger part size. This explains why general coefficientwise sufficient restrictions can be conservative and relates a natural network invariant to numerical method admissibility; it is not a named-parameter substitution or a one-off sample.
